name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Channel & Partner Marketing Manager | Reseller Partnerships, GTM Enablement & B2B Technical Sales
summary: Marketing and account leader with direct reseller-partner management experience (15-20 partners, ~94% retention at Birdeye) plus 15+ years of B2B technical sales and GTM/campaign-building across SaaS and agency environments. Comfortable translating complex product capabilities into partner- and customer-facing messaging, and building the ROI reporting that shows which programs actually produce pipeline. Direct gaps worth naming: that partner-management tenure was 14 months, not 5+ years dedicated, and it was not the current role. No cybersecurity, DevSecOps, or Federal/Public Sector partner-ecosystem experience, and no MDF/co-marketing budget management specifically.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Align marketing programs to revenue objectives directly with business owners and sales teams, producing consistent messaging and qualified lead flow.
Develop and execute full-lifecycle customer strategies spanning demand generation, sales CRM architecture, and customer success, demonstrating clear ROI and revenue growth.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured technical requirements, acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable output.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network, driving rapid adoption of marketing automation and reputation management solutions.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
